status: reviewed by the integrator (NONBLIND, developer-authored); covers only the trusted APIs the MVP already runs

adapter.connection: one AsyncSteppedConnection per actor (a one-connection stepped pool); notifications=False, so no LISTEN connection

args.ns: empty list: no job is pushed; the initial state is constructed

job_goal.id: uuid5(6f1c2a4e-9d3b-5e7f-8a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b, 'ds_sc:chancy:<n>'), as the direct constructor derives it, so the same goals give the same rows

jsonb_fields.kwargs: a JSON object equal to the handler's typed kwargs (contract jsonb/1)

schema_preconditions.triggers: none (catalog/1 screen; any trigger makes this registry inapplicable)

expected_database_behaviour.construction: one host session (application_name ds_p9x_construct), one transaction of INSERTs into chancy_jobs
expected_database_behaviour.work: the worker actor's one stepped connection; every statement corroborated against the server log

properties.C1: exactly the constructed jobs exist (none lost, none added)
properties.C2: each pending job reached succeeded, with a completion time, after exactly one attempt
properties.C3: the handler ran exactly once for each pending job, and never for a job constructed as already succeeded
properties.C4: each job kept its constructed queue, func and kwargs; a job constructed as succeeded is unchanged
properties.source: Chancy's documented job states and the workload; independent of the constructor (state_construction/chancy.py: oracle)
